title: Mitigating Cross-modal Representation Bias for Multicultural Image-to-Recipe Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-modal (image-to-recipe and recipe-to-image) retrieval performance on standard datasets by measuring median rank (medR) and Recall@K before and after applying a causal backdoor adjustment to remove spurious correlations caused by dominant visual elements.

Curating a multilingual and multicultural dataset of five cuisines (Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, India) and evaluating retrieval performance to demonstrate how representation bias disproportionately affects low-resource or non-Western cultures, mitigating it via culture-specific dictionaries and debiasing modules.
